label: Inlet, 150 mm UPVC
detail: Raw sewage enters the aerobic reactor tank through the end wall above top water level; invert depth is to be confirmed per site.

label: ART, Aerobic Reactor Tank
detail: A lower settling zone collects settleable solids at the bottom (anaerobic), and the up-chamber above the diffuser is the aeration zone that treats the flow aerobically.

label: Air diffuser
detail: Air from the blowers is piped down through the manhole to a diffuser in the ART, supplied by the manufacturer with the system.

label: FST, Final Settlement Tank
detail: A hybrid clarifier-settler behind the sloped partition, fed through the transfer pipe at the top of the partition.

label: Outlet, 150 mm UPVC
detail: Clarified effluent passes under the outlet baffle and leaves by the outlet pipe, set lower than the inlet. The system is designed for EQA Standard A effluent.

label: Blowers, 1 duty + 1 standby
detail: Diaphragm air blowers, one duty and one standby, are compulsory and sit at grade in a weatherproof blower housing built by others.

label: Top water level (TWL), H2
detail: Water level H2 is 2,000 mm above the tank base on every model from LT-40 to LT-150.
